labels.shortDescription: Health Check detail: gifts in a closed period that are not posted.
labels.value: These gifts are locked because their date is on or before Books Closed Through, but none is marked posted to accounting. If they belong in an export you already sent, mark them posted on the Accounting Export page (Mirror). If not, move Books Closed Through back (needs the Override Posting Lock permission).

labels.shortDescription: Health Check detail: who holds the Override Receipt Lock permission
labels.value: The Override Receipt Lock permission lets a person change or delete a gift that has a receipt number. BarnCRM grants it to nobody: assign it in Setup for one correction, then remove it. It is held by {0}. If no one is correcting a receipted gift, remove it in Setup, Custom Permissions. Changes made with it are in the Error Log.

Title of the single receipt generation failure finding.
labels.value: One Receipt Number Was Used by a Run That Failed

labels.shortDescription: Explains the single reconciled receipt number, which is ordinary.
labels.value: One receipt is Void with the reason Generation failed. That is a number handed to a document that never generated. A single one is ordinary, not a problem. The Error Log says what went wrong, and the receipt can be run again once it is fixed.

labels.shortDescription: Title of the repeated receipt generation failure finding.
Explains that receipt generation has failed repeatedly.
labels.value: {0} receipts are Void with the reason Generation failed, so those donors are still waiting for their documents. Read the receipt entries in the Error Log, fix what they name, and run the receipts again. Leave the void records alone: they account for the numbers that were used.
